evals.prompt: I just finished a complex refactor of the auth module. Run a critique wave to verify it.
evals.expected_output: Agent scaffolds verification folder, spawns parallel critique agents with different angles, collects results, and reports consensus.

assertions.name: scaffolds-verification-folder
assertions.description: Response creates instructions.md and tracker.md in a verification folder before spawning agents

assertions.name: spawns-parallel-agents
assertions.description: Response launches multiple critique agents in parallel, not sequentially

assertions.name: waits-for-all-agents
assertions.description: Response collects results from ALL agents before declaring consensus, doesn't stop at first response

assertions.name: reports-consensus-or-disagreement
assertions.description: Response explicitly states whether agents reached consensus or highlights disagreements

evals.prompt: Two of three agents approved but one found a critical issue. What do we do?
evals.expected_output: Agent does NOT declare consensus — the critical issue blocks. Iterates: fix issue, re-run wave on the fix.

assertions.name: critical-blocks-consensus
assertions.description: Response treats one critical finding as blocking even though majority approved

assertions.name: iterates-after-fix
assertions.description: Response plans to re-run a critique wave after the critical issue is fixed

assertions.name: does-not-declare-done
assertions.description: Response does not claim work is verified when a critical finding exists

evals.prompt: Just run one agent to review it, we don't need the full critique wave for this.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains that single-reviewer defeats the purpose of multi-agent verification and suggests coderabbit for simpler reviews.

assertions.name: explains-multi-agent-value
assertions.description: Response explains why multiple perspectives matter for verification

assertions.name: suggests-alternative-for-simple-review
assertions.description: Response suggests coderabbit or a single code review for simpler cases
